title: walkspeed
features:
this script change your walkspeed to go faster or slower

how to use

read the script :)
script:
local plrs = game.Players
local plr = plrs.LocalPlayer

walkspeed = 50; -- defule is 16 :)
-- english super
-- change number on the walkspeed to change speed
-- very pro

if plr then
    local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = walkspeed
        end
    end
end
